product_overview: Who Listening is a social multiplayer music guessing game that connects friends by challenging them to identify which friend is listening to or has liked the track currently playing. The game integrates Spotify and Deezer platforms to provide a seamless and engaging musical experience across devices.
core_goals: Create a fun, interactive, and social music guessing game that leverages personal streaming data.
Support cross-platform play with integration for Spotify and Deezer music platforms.
Ensure reliable, fast-paced gameplay with real-time synchronization and minimal latency.
Provide an intuitive and polished user experience with easy onboarding and smooth game flow.
Allow customization of user profiles and game settings to enhance user engagement.
key_features: Multi-platform authentication and onboarding via Spotify OAuth, Deezer playlist import, and anonymous Firebase Auth.
Game room system with unique 4-digit codes for creation and joining, supporting host controls like category and mode selection and bot addition.
Real-time synchronization of player lists, readiness, and game state using Firebase Firestore.
Gameplay mechanics including music pool aggregation, robust lag-resistant timers, interactive voting on track ownership, and score calculations based on speed and accuracy.
Results presentation with reveal screen showing track details and owner, dynamic real-time scoreboard, and 3D-style podium for final winners.
User profile management enabling nickname and profile picture customization with camera and gallery support.
App settings with toggles for haptics, sound effects, high-quality audio, and notifications.
Multi-language support (French and English) and a modern glassmorphism UI aesthetic with smooth animations and haptic feedback.
user_flow_summary: WelcomeScreen: User selects language and authenticates via Spotify or Deezer or uses anonymous login.
MenuScreen: User manages profile and chooses to create or join a game room.
LobbyScreen: Players wait, select categories and game modes, and the host starts the game.
GameScreen: Music previews play with a 30-second timer, players vote for the friend who owns the track, all synchronized in real-time.
RevealScreen: Results showing track info and correct player with auto-transition to next round.
GameOverScreen: Displays final podium with top three winners and options to replay or return to lobby.
validation_criteria: Authentication works correctly for Spotify OAuth, Deezer playlist import, and anonymous Firebase Firebase Auth.
Game room creation and joining using unique 4-digit codes functions reliably with real-time sync.
Host controls for category, mode selection, and bot addition are accessible and effect game state.
Music previews play within 1 second of round start consistently across devices.
Timers are robust against lag and desynchronization, preventing zombie timers and ensuring synchronized voting windows.
Voting system correctly registers player selections and calculates scores based on speed and accuracy.
Result screens accurately display track details and correct owner information with real-time leaderboard updates.
Profile customization (nickname and profile picture) saves and displays correctly.
App settings toggles affect behavior as expected (haptics, sound, audio quality, notifications).
UI/UX is polished with smooth animations, glassmorphism aesthetics, and haptic feedback responsive to user actions.
